title: Android TabWidget: content-sized tabs
purpose: Check that Android XML wrap_content tabs use their content width and shrink when the widget is too narrow.
changes: Wrap-content tab children now use Bhoo's intrinsic content measurement instead of equal-width slots. The example imports three wrap_content tabs, with a longer middle label.
steps: Turn on Wrap-content tabs. The longer middle label should have a wider tab than First and Third.
Turn on Narrow widget. The tabs should shrink to fit; the labels may be clipped in the smaller space.
Turn on Right-to-left layout and check that the order reverses. Tap the middle tab to check selection.
Choose OK if it works, or Reject with details and your device.
expected: Tab widths follow the content, shrink when space is limited, and preserve selection and RTL ordering.
limits: Content width uses Bhoo's approximate font metrics. Match-parent mixtures, Android's detailed measurement and device appearance remain unverified or approximate.

references.scope: Unconstrained first measurement and overflow distribution.

validation: Thirteen TabWidget Rust tests, seven TabHost tests and 156 XML importer tests passed; tests include dynamic text and overflow.
A 320 × 760 browser test checked content sizing, narrow layout, selection and RTL.
